First public preview of the independent Android client for MeshCentral.

- Android 8.0 or later; a MeshCentral account and your own HTTPS server are required.
- Enter your server address on first launch. No personal server or background update service is configured.
- Native remote desktop, keyboard, clipboard, zoom and connection recovery.
- Saved credentials are bound to the complete server endpoint.
- Updates are installed manually from GitHub Releases.

Download the APK below, allow your browser/file manager to install it, and open the downloaded file.
Future public releases use the same application ID and signing certificate and install over this version.
This public application is separate from earlier private builds and requires a fresh sign-in.

`SHA256SUMS` verifies the APK file; `release-info.json` records its package, version and certificate fingerprint.
See README, PRIVACY.md and docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md before use. This is a preview, not a guarantee of compatibility
with every server. Physical devices, SSO-only accounts, custom certificate authorities and the complete range of
MeshCentral deployments have not been accepted for this release.
